about: The same site, the same facts and sources, in six designs. Premiere is the home page. The master copy of the facts is /index.md; the picker is /d/.

designs.name: Premiere
designs.idea: Cinematic: his portrait out of the dark, his films, then every video and playlist, playable in the page.

designs.name: The Studio
designs.idea: A studio at night: his work first, each section explained with a drawing.

designs.name: The Sleeve
designs.idea: A record sleeve and liner notes, after the look of his COR cover: Side A the music, Side B how it was made.

designs.name: The Cue Sheet
designs.idea: A film composer's cue sheet: a letterboxed frame, reel by reel, with his own film and TV cues.

designs.name: The Score
designs.idea: A printed score in six movements: paper, ink and oxblood, figures as plates.

designs.name: The Signal Chain
designs.idea: A studio rack and patch bay, from input to output: LEDs and monospace labels.
